reaudit_finding_detail: The pre-reaudit _train_refit_stability refit the full procedure panel atomically per replicate and, on any refit failure, skipped the replicate while still computing TRAIN-refit intervals from the surviving successful replicates. This violated frozen R3_PROTOCOL.md section 17, which requires the affected procedure/model block to be INCOMPLETE and forbids a successful-subset interval.

failure_contract.resample_reuse: one deterministic resampled TRAIN multiset per replicate, reused across all procedures

analyses_not_run: Fisher combination / six primary factorial contrasts
analyses_not_run_evidentiary_basis: No committed R3 confirmatory statistical analysis artifact, and no committed post-outcome analysis-code change, existed before this correction; the project's recorded gate state was analysis NOT RUN / LOCKED. This statement is bounded by the committed record and does not claim filesystem history beyond it.
